notes.title: Version 0.39
notes.notes:
Almost there! Version 0.40 is next. So, what does this version bring?

-Added homestones that you can use any time to return to the region's home base,
usually a town.
-Added traveling NPCs to many of the maps.
-Updated the regional map graphics.
-Fixed up some of the "emptier" looking maps and fixed map elevations.
-There is now a traveling merchant on some maps that let you buy things such as the Atlas, if you missed it on Atlas Mountain (Lakeside Cliffs)
-Weaker monsters are destroyed instantly (mostly, version 0.40 should finish this) but on the flipside, if you're too much weaker than the monsters, they'll destroy you on touch! Beware!
-Updated regional maps (can be seen by pressing M)

notes.title: More work towards the spring/summer update, version 0.40
notes.notes:
Version 0.31 is now version 0.37, and there have been some things added. If you are too strong for the enemies you can run into them to cause them to get destroyed on touch. (This can be turned off if you prefer)

However, if you are instead too weak for the enemies, your party will instead get destroyed on touch! (If your level is less than two-thirds of the enemies' level, once they hit level 20, and a flat five levels lower than the enemy's if level 19 and lower)

notes.title: February Update (fixes Leap Year bug, hero has map of first few areas)
notes.notes:
Version 0.2.3 fixes the Leap Year bug, but the game is still playable even without the fix- you'd just jump to March 1. Since the game starts on September 21, it is highly unlikely a player would reach February 29 this early on without changing the date in Lakeland Town. 

You also no longer need the Atlas to see the map in Lakeland Town, Lakeland Field or Lakeside Cliffs- South. It makes sense that the hero would already have some sort of map of his immediate surroundings. To see this map, press the M key on the keyboard.

notes.title: January Update (version 0.2.0)
notes.notes:
Let's not eat my update this time...

Some changes are in store, such as some new intro pictures, and jumping is a bit more proper now. The hero won't jump from the ground to the top of a 50-foot high cliff- or at least they shouldn't.

If you take too long to get to the Lakeside Cliffs overlook after getting the bridge fixed, something interesting just might happen.

But yeah, we're FINALLY out of version 0.1.x and into the 0.2.x range! How long until 0.3.0 is reached?

notes.title: Minor update- getting it ready for the December Update in about two weeks
notes.notes: Now can explore most of Lakeland Island (except for Dragon's Head Point, Lakeland Icefields NW and NE, the Skyhaven and Underworld, as well most sea maps).

notes.title: Update from 0.1.1 to 0.1.7 (November Update)
notes.notes:
You can now explore even more of the island!
-Added several new areas for exploration, Lakeland Highlands, Lowlands, Spiral Mountains, Swamp of Disappointment, Lakeland Coastal Route!
-Up over 600 maps to explore!
